alaa-alkhatib.name: Alaa Alkhatib
alaa-alkhatib.bio: Alaa Alkhatib is a Vienna-based Austrian-Syrian researcher and policy analyst with more than 25 years of research experience, including previous work at IIASA and the IAEA. Since 2016, his independent research has focused increasingly on Syria and the wider Middle East, political Islam, migration, identity and disinformation. He publishes through InfoSalam, an independent multilingual platform in Arabic, English and German.

fabrizio-floris.name: Fabrizio Floris
fabrizio-floris.bio: Fabrizio Floris is a sociologist and teaches Sociology of Development at Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore in Milan. His research focuses on urban transformation, informal economies, inequality and the social consequences of deindustrialisation. He has conducted ethnographic research in Mirafiori and in urban communities in Kenya, and has written for Italian and international publications.

erik-oddvar-eriksen.name: Erik Oddvar Eriksen
erik-oddvar-eriksen.bio: Erik Oddvar Eriksen is professor emeritus at ARENA Centre for European Studies, University of Oslo, which he directed from 2008 to 2020. His research covers political theory, public policy and European integration, with a particular focus on democratic legitimacy in the European Union and on the position of non-member states. His latest book is Mechanisms of European Integration: The Force of Reasons (Routledge, 2025).
erik-oddvar-eriksen.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

claes-mikael-stahl.name: Claes-Mikael Ståhl
claes-mikael-stahl.bio: Claes-Mikael Ståhl (cmstahl@etuc.org) has been deputy general secretary at the European Trade Union Confederation since September 2021. He deals primarily with social dialogue, trade and standardisation.

andrew-watt.name: Andrew Watt
andrew-watt.bio: Andrew Watt is general director of the European Trade Union Institute.

jorn-bjerre.name: Jørn Bjerre
jorn-bjerre.bio: Jørn Bjerre is Associate Professor of Educational Sociology at the Danish School of Education, Aarhus University. His research focuses on social theory, education, and the formation of social and institutional orders.

alejandro-garcia-esteban.name: Alejandro García Esteban
alejandro-garcia-esteban.bio: Alejandro García Esteban is a political adviser to the Socialists and Democrats group in the European Parliament, working on international trade policy.
alejandro-garcia-esteban.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

piergiuseppe-fortunato.name: Piergiuseppe Fortunato
piergiuseppe-fortunato.bio: Piergiuseppe Fortunato is a senior economist at the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development, where he leads projects on global value chains and economic integration, and an external professor of political economics at the Université de Neuchâtel.

joanna-demopoulou.name: Joanna Demopoulou
joanna-demopoulou.bio: Joanna Demopoulou holds a PhD in International Affairs and is a former Executive in Residence at the Geneva Centre for Security Policy (GCSP). Her research examines the institutional architecture of governance in European and international institutions.

enrique-fernandez-macias.name: Enrique Fernández-Macías
enrique-fernandez-macias.bio: Enrique Fernández-Macías is a Researcher working in the Joint Research Centre (JRC) of the European Commission in Sevilla. He holds a PhD in Economic Sociology by the University of Salamanca, and his main research interests are job quality, technology & occupational change and the division of labour. Before joining the JRC, he worked in the University of Salamanca and Eurofound (Dublin).

judith-kirton-darling.name: Judith Kirton-Darling
judith-kirton-darling.bio: Judith Kirton-Darling is general secretary of industriAll European Trade Union. She was a British member of the European Parliament between 2014 and 2020 and confederal secretary of the European Trade Union Confederation.

jan-willem-goudriaan.name: Jan Willem Goudriaan
jan-willem-goudriaan.bio: Jan Willem Goudriaan has been general secretary of the European Federation of Public Service Unions (EPSU) since 2014.

sonja-hennen.name: Sonja Hennen
sonja-hennen.bio: Sonja Hennen is a Policy Advisor for European Transformation Policy at the German Trade Union Confederation. Her work focuses on EU cohesion and structural policy, including regional development and investment strategies, as well as just transition policies to support workers and regions affected by climate and industrial transformation.

dominika-biegon.name: Dominika Biegon

kate-pickett.name: Kate Pickett
kate-pickett.bio: Kate Pickett is Professor of Epidemiology and director of the Born in Bradford Centre for Social Change at the University of York, and co-director of Health Equity North. She is co-author, with Richard Wilkinson, of The Spirit Level (2009) and The Inner Level (2018), and author of The Good Society (2026).
kate-pickett.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

wouter-zwysen.name: Wouter Zwysen
wouter-zwysen.bio: Wouter Zwysen is a senior researcher at the European Trade Union Institute, working  on labour-market inequality and wages, and ethnic and migrant disadvantage.

dani-rodrik.name: Dani Rodrik
dani-rodrik.bio: Dani Rodrik, professor of international political economy at Harvard University’s John F Kennedy School of Government, is president of the International Economic Association and  author of Straight Talk on Trade: Ideas for a Sane World Economy (Princeton University Press).

richard-demeny.name: Richard Demeny
richard-demeny.bio: Richard Demeny is an expert on informational autocracy at the Political Capital Institute in Budapest.

peter-kreko.name: Péter Krekó

ilan-kapoor.name: Ilan Kapoor
ilan-kapoor.bio: Ilan Kapoor is Professor of Critical Development Studies at the Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change at York University in Toronto. He is the author of seven books on global politics and critical development studies, and a regular op-ed contributor, including for Al Jazeera and The Conversation.

tibor-dessewffy.name: Tibor Dessewffy
tibor-dessewffy.bio: Tibor Dessewffy is the Director of the Digital Sociology Research Center at Eotvos Lorand University in Budapest and a council member of the European Council on Foreign Relations (ECFR).

christophe-sente.name: Christophe Sente
christophe-sente.bio: Christophe Sente is a fellow of Cevipol (Centre d’Étude de la Vie politique) at the Université Libre de Bruxelles. His areas of interest include the history of ideas, the evolution of party systems and the transformations of democracy.

timothee-duverger.name: Timothée Duverger

german-bender.name: German Bender
german-bender.bio: German Bender is chief analyst at the progressive Swedish thinktank Arena and a researcher affiliated to Stockholm School of Economics and Harvard Law School.

faye-holder.name: Faye Holder
faye-holder.bio: Faye Holder is programme manager for oil and gas, digital media and advertising at InfluenceMap, a think tank which provides data and analysis on how business and finance are affecting the climate crisis. She has a masters in environment, politics and globalisation from King's College London.

frederik-hafen.name: Frederik Hafen
frederik-hafen.bio: Frederik Hafen is policy officer for environmental democracy at the European Environmental Bureau (EEB). He has a masters in European public affairs from Maastricht University and was formerly policy adviser in the cabinet of the European ombudsman.

romain-didi.name: Romain Didi
romain-didi.bio: Romain Didi is climate-governance and human-rights policy co-ordinator at Climate Action Network (CAN) Europe.

laura-hildt.name: Laura Hildt
laura-hildt.bio: Laura Hildt is a policy officer for biodiversity at the European Environmental Bureau.

ioannis-agapakis.name: Ioannis Agapakis

piotr-buras.name: Piotr Buras
piotr-buras.bio: Piotr Buras is a senior policy fellow at the European Council on Foreign Relations and head of its Warsaw office. He was formerly a columnist and Berlin correspondent for Gazeta Wyborcza, the biggest Polish daily newspaper.

magdalena-ulceluse.name: Magdalena Ulceluse
magdalena-ulceluse.bio: Magdalena Ulceluse is an assistant professor in international migration and ethnic relations at Malmo University's Institute for Studies of Migration, Diversity and Welfare, having held positions at the University of Groningen and Central European University. Her research focuses on intra-EU mobility, migration and development/inequality and the local governance of migration.
magdalena-ulceluse.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

peter-bofinger.name: Peter Bofinger
peter-bofinger.bio: Peter Bofinger is professor of economics at Würzburg University and a former member of the German Council of Economic Experts.

david-hollanders.name: David Hollanders
david-hollanders.bio: David Hollanders is a lecturer in economics in the Department of European Studies at the University of Amsterdam.

susanne-wixforth.name: Susanne Wixforth
susanne-wixforth.bio: Susanne Wixforth is deputy head of the Economic Policy Department in the Vienna Chamber of Labour.
susanne-wixforth.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

christian-berger.name: Christian Berger

michael-dauderstaedt.name: Michael Dauderstädt
michael-dauderstaedt.bio: Michael Dauderstädt is a freelance consultant and writer. Until 2013, he was director of the division for economic and social policy of the Friedrich Ebert Stiftung.

mary-mccaughey.name: Mary McCaughey
mary-mccaughey.bio: Mary McCaughey is head of information and communication at Eurofound. A graduate of Trinity College Dublin and of the College of Europe, Bruges, Mary has an early background in journalism and has contributed to a wide range of publications, including the Wall Street Journal Europe and the Irish Times.

nicoletta-pirozzi.name: Nicoletta Pirozzi
nicoletta-pirozzi.bio: Nicoletta Pirozzi is head of the EU programme and institutional-relations manager at the Istituto Affari Internazionali (IAI), specialising in EU politics and institutions, Italian foreign policy and international security. She is president of MondoDem, a progressive foreign-policy network, and a founding member of ProgressiveActs.

tuscany-bell.name: Tuscany Bell
tuscany-bell.bio: Tuscany Bell is policy co-ordinator for social services and youth at the European Federation of Public Service Unions (EPSU).

ffewfgfrerwfewfrefre.name: Magdalena Sepúlveda Carmona
ffewfgfrerwfewfrefre.bio: Magdalena Sepúlveda Carmona is Director of the United Nations Research Institute for Social Development (UNRISD) and commissioner of the Independent Commission for the Reform of International Corporate Taxation (ICRICT).

sylvia-obregon.name: Sylvia Obregon Quiroz
sylvia-obregon.bio: Sylvia Obregon Quiroz is a policy officer at the European Coalition for Corporate Justice.

camilla-barungi.name: Camilla Barungi
camilla-barungi.bio: Camilla Barungi is managing director of the Tooro Omutoma Project, a cultural industrial accelerator in Uganda, and editor-in-chief of Jaro4ME, a multimedia platform focused on the African diaspora. She has been a regular speaker on sustainability at United Nations summits, including the NGO Conference and the ECOSOC Forum on Financing for Development.

kaoutar-haddouti.name: Kaoutar Haddouti

branko-milanovic.name: Branko Milanovic
branko-milanovic.bio: Branko Milanovic is a Serbian-American economist. A development and inequality specialist, he is visiting presidential professor at the Graduate Center of City University of New York and an affiliated senior scholar at the Luxembourg Income Study. He was formerly lead economist in the World Bank's research department.

robert-donoghue.name: Robert Donoghue
robert-donoghue.bio: Robert Donoghue is a PhD candidate in social and policy sciences at the University of Bath, focusing on the ethical workplace and how workplaces are transformed by 'smart' technologies. He is also a research officer at the University of Essex, writing about legislation globally on artificial intelligence for the Research Department of the International Labour Organization.

neal-lawson.name: Neal Lawson
neal-lawson.bio: Neal Lawson is the executive director of Compass but writes here in a personal capacity. He was editor of The Causes and Cures of Brexit, has helped convene conversations and publications for many years on Europe and the Good Society and was the spokesperson for the Progressive Alliance in the 2017 UK general election.
neal-lawson.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

peter-verovsek.name: Peter Verovšek
peter-verovsek.bio: Peter J. Verovšek teaches history and theory of European integration at the University of Groningen in The Netherlands. He is the author of Jürgen Habermas: Public Intellectual and Engaged Critical Theorist (Columbia University Press, 2026).

eunice-goes.name: Eunice Goes
eunice-goes.bio: Eunice Goes is professor of politics at Richmond American University London and author most recently of Social Democracy (Agenda Publishing, 2024).

gavin-rae.name: Gavin Rae
gavin-rae.bio: Gavin Rae is a sociologist in Warsaw. He has written extensively on the political and social changes in Poland and central and eastern Europe, including Poland's Return to Capitalism: From the Socialist Bloc to the European Union and Public Capital: The Commodification of Poland's Welfare State.
gavin-rae.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

peter-scherrer.name: Peter Scherrer
peter-scherrer.bio: Peter Scherrer is deputy general secretary of the European Trade Union Confederation, Brussels.
peter-scherrer.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

henning-meyer.name: Henning Meyer
henning-meyer.bio: Henning Meyer is Editor-in-Chief of Social Europe and Director of the lill Institute for Public Value. He is also Honorary Professor of Public Policy and Business at the Eberhard Karls University of Tübingen and Research Associate at the Centre for Business Research at Cambridge University. He previously served as Chief of Staff and Director General for Policy at a German state Ministry of Finance and Science and was the first Fellow of the German Federal Ministry of Finance.

frederick-ahen.name: Frederick Ahen
frederick-ahen.bio: Frederick Ahen is Research Fellow at the Turku School of Economics, University of Turku, Department of Marketing and International Business. Frederick’s research straddles the areas of sustainable global health governance and the role of business and non-business actors in changing institutions.

michael-davies-venn.name: Michael Davies-Venn
michael-davies-venn.bio: Michael Davies-Venn is a public-policy analyst and political-communications expert, based in Berlin, focused on issues of global governance, including climate change and human rights. He is a guest researcher in the Ethics of the Anthropocene Programme at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam.

marc-saxer.name: Marc Saxer
marc-saxer.bio: Marc Saxer is a member of the SPD's Basic Values Commission. His book Transformative Realism: Overcoming the System Crisis was published in 2021.

massimiliano-santini.name: Massimiliano Santini
massimiliano-santini.bio: Massimiliano Santini (massimiliano.santini@eui.eu) is a policy leaders fellow with the European University Institute and a senior economist on leave from the World Bank. He is a graduate of Harvard Kennedy School and holds a bachelor degree in economics from the University of Modena in Italy.

montserrat-mir-roca.name: Montserrat Mir Roca
montserrat-mir-roca.bio: Montserrat Mir Roca is Confederal Secretary of the European Trade Union Confederation. Previously, she was a member of the national executive of the CC.OO trade union in Spain.
montserrat-mir-roca.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

marcello-minenna.name: Marcello Minenna
marcello-minenna.bio: Marcello Minenna is head of the quantitative analysis unit in Consob (the Italian Securities and Exchange Commission). He has taught quantitative finance at Bocconi University and at the London Graduate School of Mathematical Finance. He is a regular writer for the Wall Street Journal and Corriere della Sera and is a member of an advisory group which supports the economic analysis of the biggest Italian trade union, CGIL.
marcello-minenna.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

steve-coulter.name: Steve Coulter
steve-coulter.bio: Steve Coulter is head of communications at the European Trade Union Institute and a visiting fellow in the European Institute of the London School of Economics and Political Science.

thorvaldur-gylfason.name: Thorvaldur Gylfason
thorvaldur-gylfason.bio: Thorvaldur Gylfason is professor emeritus of economics at the University of Iceland and a former member of Iceland´s Constitutional Council.

guido-montani.name: Guido Montani
guido-montani.bio: Guido Montani is professor of international political economy at the University of Pavia. He is a former president of the European Federalist Movement in Italy. He founded in 1987, in Ventotene, the Altiero Spinelli Institute for Federalist Studies. His latest book is Anthropocene and Cosmopolitan Citizenship: Europe and the New International Order (Routledge, 2024).

denis-mcshane.name: Denis MacShane
denis-mcshane.bio: Denis MacShane was a Labour MP (1994-2012) and served as UK minister of Europe. He writes regularly on European politics and Brexit.

gabriele-de-angelis.name: Gabriele de Angelis
gabriele-de-angelis.bio: Gabriele de Angelis is a political theorist working as a researcher at the Universidade Nova de Lisboa. His current research is focused on the reform of the economic governance in the European Union, especially with regard to normative aspects.

una-bergmane.name: Una Bergmane
una-bergmane.bio: Una Bergmane is a Teaching Fellow at the London School of Economics and Baltic Sea Fellow at the Foreign Policy Research Institute in Philadelphia.

shayn-mccallum.name: Shayn McCallum
shayn-mccallum.bio: Shayn McCallum is an Australian-born resident of Istanbul and PES activist (working as a member of the Irish Labour Party and French Socialist Party). He is employed as an instructor at Bogazici University in Istanbul and is also currently working on his doctoral thesis on the subject of European Social Democracy.

steven-hill.name: Steven Hill
steven-hill.bio: Steven Hill is author of Europe's Promise: Why the European Way Is the Best Hope in an Insecure Age, a former journalist in residence at the Berlin Social Science Center (WZB) and a former Holtzbrinck fellow at the American Academy in Berlin.

istvan-pogany.name: Stephen Pogány
istvan-pogany.bio: Stephen Pogány is emeritus professor in the School of Law, University of Warwick. His latest book is Modern Times: The Biography of a Hungarian-Jewish Family (2021).

manuel-muniz.name: Manuel Muñiz
manuel-muniz.bio: Manuel Muniz is Provost of IE University and a Professor of Practice of International Relations.

martin-seeleib-kaiser.name: Martin Seeleib-Kaiser
martin-seeleib-kaiser.bio: Martin Seeleib-Kaiser is Barnett Professor of Comparative Social Policy and Politics, University of Oxford

david-held.name: David Held
david-held.bio: David Held is Master of University College, Durham, and Professor of Politics and International Relations at Durham University.

john-ryan.name: John Ryan
john-ryan.bio: Professor John Ryan is a Fellow at LSE Ideas (International Strategy and Diplomacy). He works as a senior Brexit adviser for private and public sector organisations.

jakub-patocka.name: Jakub Patočka
jakub-patocka.bio: Jakub Patocka is currently Editor in Chief of the left-liberal online newspaper Deník Referendum, founder of the Friends of the Earth movement in the Czech Republic and former member of the leadership of the Czech Green Party (2003-2005). He is now a member of the Social Democratic Party.

anand-menon.name: Anand Menon
anand-menon.bio: Anand Menon is Professor of European Politics and Foreign Affairs at King's College London in the United Kingdom.
anand-menon.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

clare-coatman.name: Clare Coatman
clare-coatman.bio: Clare Coatman is campaigns and ideas organiser at Compass.

vivien-schmidt.name: Vivien Schmidt
vivien-schmidt.bio: Vivien A Schmidt is Jean Monnet professor of European integration in the Pardee School at Boston University and honorary professor at LUISS Guido Carli University in Rome. Her latest book is Europe’s Crisis of Legitimacy: Governing by Rules and Ruling by Numbers in the Eurozone (Oxford University Press).
vivien-schmidt.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

eva-nordmark.name: Eva Nordmark
eva-nordmark.bio: Eva Nordmark is minister for employment in Sweden.
eva-nordmark.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

thomas-fricke.name: Thomas Fricke
thomas-fricke.bio: Thomas Fricke is Chief Economist at the Financial Times Deutschland.

veronica-nilsson.name: Veronica Nilsson
veronica-nilsson.bio: Veronica Nilsson is General Secretary of the Trade Union Advisory Committee to the OECD (TUAC).

simon-deakin.name: Simon Deakin
simon-deakin.bio: Simon Deakin is Professor of Law and Director of the Centre for Business Research (CBR) at the University of Cambridge.

sandro-scocco.name: Sandro Scocco
sandro-scocco.bio: Sandro Scocco is Chief Economist at the Stockholm-based think tank Arena Idé and has a background as the Chief Economist of the governmental research institute ITPS. He is also a former Director at the Labour Market Board and served during the 1990s as an adviser to several Swedish social democratic ministers.

johannes-schweighofer.name: Johannes Schweighofer
johannes-schweighofer.bio: Johannes Schweighofer is a senior economist at the Austrian Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs. His main responsibilities are international labour market policies (EU, OECD, ILO) and research. He is a long-standing member of the EU-Employment Committee and the OECD Working Party on Employment. Recently, he has published articles on labour market effects of immigration, youth employment and the effectiveness of labour market programmes. He writes in a strictly personal capacity.

joseph-stiglitz.name: Joseph Stiglitz
joseph-stiglitz.bio: Joseph E Stiglitz, a Nobel laureate in economics and professor at Columbia University, is a former chief economist of the World Bank, chair of the US president’s Council of Economic Advisers and co-chair of the High-Level Commission on Carbon Prices. He is a member of the Independent Commission for the Reform of International Corporate Taxation.
joseph-stiglitz.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

dimitris-tsarouhas.name: Dimitris Tsarouhas
dimitris-tsarouhas.bio: Dimitris Tsarouhas is Assistant Professor in European Politics at Bilkent University and editorial board member of Social Europe journal. A  member of the Scientific Council of the Foundation for European Progressive Studies (FEPS), he is the author of Social Democracy in Sweden (London and New York: IB Tauris 2008) and various articles on European politics.
dimitris-tsarouhas.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

markus-krajewski.name: Markus Krajewski
markus-krajewski.bio: Markus Krajewski is Professor of Law at the University of Erlangen-Nürnberg.

hans-dubois.name: Hans Dubois
hans-dubois.bio: Hans Dubois is research manager in the social-policies unit at Eurofound in Dublin.

robin-wilson.name: Robin Wilson
robin-wilson.bio: Robin Wilson (josephrobinsonwilson@gmail.eu) is an expert adviser to the Council of Europe on intercultural integration and was principal drafter of its model framework for national integration plans. He is the author of Meeting the Challenge of Cultural Diversity in Europe: Moving Beyond the Crisis (Edward Elgar).

john-weeks.name: John Weeks
john-weeks.bio: John Weeks is co-ordinator of the London-based Progressive Economy Forum and professor emeritus of the School of Oriental and African Studies. He is author of The Debt Delusion: Living within Our Means and Other Fallacies (2019) and Economics of the 1%: How Mainstream Economics Services the Rich, Obscures Reality and Distorts Policy.
john-weeks.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

nouriel-roubini.name: Nouriel Roubini
nouriel-roubini.bio: Nouriel Roubini, a senior adviser at Hudson Bay Capital Management LP and Professor Emeritus of Economics at New York University’s Stern School of Business, is Co-Founder of Atlas Capital Team, CEO of Roubini Macro Associates, Co-Founder of TheBoomBust.com, and author of Megathreats: Ten Dangerous Trends That Imperil Our Future, and How to Survive Them (Little, Brown and Company, 2022).

george-tyler.name: George Tyler
george-tyler.bio: George Tyler is a former US deputy Treasury assistant secretary and senior official at the World Bank. He is the author of What Went Wrong: How the 1% Hijacked the American Middle Class ... And What Other Nations Got Right.

kurt-huebner.name: Kurt Huebner
kurt-huebner.bio: Kurt Huebner is Professor of European Studies and the Jean Monnet Chair at the Institute for European Studies at the University of British Columbia, Canada.

robert-shiller.name: Robert Shiller
robert-shiller.bio: Robert Shiller, Professor of Economics at Yale University and Chief Economist at MacroMarkets LLC, is co-author, with George Akerlof, of Animal Spirits: How Human Psychology Drives the Economy and Why It Matters for Global Capitalism.
robert-shiller.avatarBoxHtml: Photo credit

joseph-allchin.name: Joseph Allchin
joseph-allchin.bio: Joseph Allchin is a British-born journalist based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. He's written for the Financial Times, the Guardian, the Economist, the New York Times, Foreign Policy amongst others. Follow him on twitter @J_allchin.

ingolfur-bluehdorn.name: Ingolfur Blühdorn
ingolfur-bluehdorn.bio: Ingolfur Blühdorn is Reader in Politics/Political Sociology at the University of Bath in the UK.

carlo-bordoni.name: Carlo Bordoni
carlo-bordoni.bio: Carlo Bordoni is an Italian sociologist and writes for Il Corriere della Sera. He is author of State of Crisis (2014) with Zygmunt Bauman. Among his recent works are The Society of Dividuals (Polity 2026), Public Intimacy. The Dissolution of the Private in Liquid Society (Routledge 2026) and Ethical Violence (Polity 2024).

lola-avril.name: Lola Avril
lola-avril.bio: Lola Avril is a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Eastern Finland.

emilia-korkea-aho.name: Emilia Korkea-aho

antoine-vauchez.name: Antoine Vauchez

werner-raza.name: Werner Raza
werner-raza.bio: Werner Raza is director of the Austrian Foundation for Development Research (ÖFSE) in Vienna.

bernhard-troster.name: Bernhard Tröster
bernhard-troster.bio: Bernhard Tröster is a researcher at the Austrian Foundation for Development Research (ÖFSE) in Vienna.

verena-madner.name: Verena Madner

birgit-hollaus.name: Birgit Hollaus

stefan-mayr.name: Stefan Mayr
